name: tap
use: Buttons, list items, tabs, chips, cards
prompt: A single tiny water droplet falling onto a still water surface, very close microphone, crisp soft plip, extremely short, dry, no reverb, no music, no tone

name: toggle_on
description: A small pebble dropped into shallow water
prompt: A small smooth pebble dropped into shallow water, short bright plunk with a tiny splash, close up, natural, no music

name: toggle_off
description: A pebble lifted out of water
prompt: A small pebble lifted out of shallow water, short soft wet drip and suction, close up, natural, no music

name: select
description: A fingertip tick on a dry leaf
use: Selecting an option, radio buttons, picking a list item in multi-select
prompt: One single isolated soft tick of a fingertip on a dry leaf, then complete silence, one hit only, very close, dry, no reverb, no music

name: long_press
description: A slow press into wet sand
prompt: A palm pressing slowly into wet sand, soft compressing squish, short, close up, natural, no music

name: swipe
description: A hand brushing quickly across smooth sand
use: Swipe actions on list rows, dismissing cards
prompt: A hand brushing quickly across smooth dry sand, one short soft swish, close up, natural, no music

name: drag_start
use: Picking up an item to drag or reorder
prompt: A smooth pebble picked up from fine gravel, small short scrape, close up, natural, no music

name: drop
description: A pebble set down on sand
use: Dropping a dragged item into place, reorder complete
prompt: A smooth pebble set down onto damp sand, one soft muted settle, close up, natural, no music

name: slider_tick
description: A grain of sand landing on a leaf
use: Slider and picker detents, scroll wheel ticks
prompt: One single tiny crisp tick of a dry seed tapped on a hard wooden surface, sharp attack, then complete silence, one hit only, very close, dry, no music

name: keyboard_tap
description: A fingertip tap on smooth wood
use: Custom in-app keyboards, PIN pads, number pads
prompt: One single isolated fingertip tap on a smooth wooden desk, then complete silence, one hit only, very close, dry, no reverb, no music

name: pull_release
prompt: A bent green reed released and springing back, quick soft airy flick, close up, natural, no music

name: scroll_edge
description: A muffled bump against wet sand
use: Reaching the end of a list or carousel
prompt: A soft muffled bump of a fist against wet sand, very short and dull, close up, natural, no music
